data.long_meaning: Jananiyaa is a Sanskrit name derived from the word Janani, which means mother. The suffix -yaa is a feminine suffix, making Jananiyaa a female name. In Hindu mythology, Jananiyaa is considered to be the mother of the universe, nurturing and caring for all living beings. The name Jananiyaa carries the meaning “Mother of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jananiyaa usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
